L303: ## 4. The Image of $\mathsf{Pop}$
L304: 
L305: Our goal in this section is to characterize the image of the pop-stack operator on the ornamentation lattice $\mathcal{O}(\mathsf{T})$. This characterization, which we describe in cite66†Theorem 4.2 , is given by imposing a simple local criterion on each ornament in an ornamentation.
L306: Let $\mathsf{T}\in\mathrm{PT}_{n}$ and $\delta\in\mathcal{O}(\mathsf{T})$. For convenience, we add to $\mathsf{T}$ an extra imaginary node $\omega$, and we let $\delta(\omega)=\{\omega\}\cup\mathsf{T}$. We make the convention that $\omega$ is the parent of the root $\mathfrak{r}$ and that $\mathfrak{r}$ is the unique child of $\omega$. We impose that the ornament hung at $\omega$ is left unaffected by $\mathsf{Pop}$.
